answer_1.quote: Given a relational database, Text-to-SQL is the task of translating a natural language question into a SQL query ... We propose using ORM code to bridge the dialect gap in Text-to-SQL.
answer_1.outputs: ORM code snippets and dialect-specific SQL queries

answer_2.quote: We follow the convention to report three metrics for Text-to-SQL: Execution Accuracy (EX), Exact Matching Accuracy (EM), and Valid Efficiency Score (VES).
